step_by_step_reasoning:
1. Identify all visual nodes on the whiteboard canvas:
   - Ingestion path (bottom): Kinesis Data Stream ('KINESIS'), ECS ('ECS'), S3 ('S3').
   - Search path (top/middle): ECS ('ECS'), DynamoDB ('DYNAMODB'), Lambda ('LAMBDA' - job dispatcher), SQS ('SQS'), Step Functions ('STEP FUNCTION'), Lambda ('LAMBDA' - worker/filter functions), S3 ('S3' - temporary results), Kinesis Data Stream ('KINESIS'), Lambda ('LAMBDA' - aggregator function partially visible on the right edge).
2. Identify all drawn directed arrows:
   - Ingestion path: Ingest arrow -> Kinesis -> ECS -> S3.
   - Search path: Search request -> top ECS -> first Lambda -> SQS, Step Functions, and second Lambda.
   - Filter Lambda -> S3 and Kinesis.
   - Kinesis and Filter Lambda -> Aggregator Lambda.
3. Assign strictly allowed AWS service names from Rule 1 (e.g., 'KinesisDataStream', 'ECS', 'S3', 'DynamoDB', 'Lambda', 'SQS', 'StepFunctions').
4. Build edges based exclusively on visual lines drawn on the board with appropriate flow_id and seq identifiers.

graph.name: AlertLogic Serverless Log Search and Data Ingestion Architecture
graph.notes: Architecture showing a 25PB log ingestion pipeline into S3 and a massive parallel MapReduce search engine using thousands of Lambda functions coordinated via Step Functions and SQS.

nodes.name: Data Ingestion Stream
nodes.notes: Receives log data from customer fleet agents and appliances.

nodes.name: Pre-processing ECS Cluster
nodes.notes: Performs pre-processing on incoming log streams.

nodes.name: Search Planner ECS
nodes.notes: Validates search queries and plans execution.

nodes.name: Job Shadowing Lambda
nodes.notes: Schedules and coordinates job execution based on customer data volume.

nodes.name: Filter Lambda Fleet
nodes.notes: Spins up thousands of instances to filter and enrich log data.

nodes.name: Aggregation Lambda
nodes.notes: Aggregates search results to return to user.
